answer: The checker pulls his wick through the fingers, and the pull must run smooth or the wick will snag in the mould. Taper palm soap curer chandler warrant covers the pulling: a warrant palm soap curers hold after curing room trials. The mirror is the first pull, made at the bench; the trellis is the last, made before the wicks are cut, and the ripple is the bench itself, smooth with wax. A cheat must pull 67 false wicks and cut 67 false benches.
